title: Genius
desc: An orphan with a genius mind hatches a plan to avenge the killing of his colleagues in order to live in peace with the one he loves.

title: International Rowdy
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

title: Dil Madharaasi
desc: Heartbroken by a recent split, a troubled individual joins a mission to halt an illegal arms distribution syndicate. Subsequently, he struggles with his painful history to prevent catastrophe.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Koyla
desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.

title: Chakkiligintha
desc: Adi is a love guru and advises boys not to express their love for girls until they reveal their true feelings. As a challenge, Avi decides to make Adi fall in love with her.

title: Mad About Dance
desc: A man has a dream of becoming a world-famous dancer but struggles to impress the people around him. However, this does not stop him from scratching and clawing his way to the top.

title: Bhai Mera Big Brother
desc: A hitman turns against his boss and decide to help an undercover police officer when he learns about his real identity.

title: Loafer - The Hero
desc: Raja, a young thief, lives with his father and believes his mother to be dead. However, things become complicated when he comes across Mouni, a runaway girl, and falls for her.

title: Khiladi
desc: Pooja, a criminologist, along with Arjun, a CBI official, tries to solve two interlinked cases of murder and money laundering. As they investigate the crimes, the conspiracy intensifies.

title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.

title: Radhe Shyam
desc: Despite being a doctor with no inclination towards superstitious beliefs, Prerana places her love and faith in Aditya, a palmist whose predictions turn out to be too spot-on to be disregarded.

title: Aparichit - The Stranger
desc: A meek lawyer, frustrated with his inability to change the system, develops a vigilante alter-ego to mete out justice to criminals. However, the police soon set out to track down the vigilante.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers make elaborate plans to earn money by investing in buildings but are conned by Kabir, who leaves them unemployed and penniless. Soon, they are on the prowl to avenge their humiliation.
